chapterInfo.content:
9
Onifirani bi adehunu
1Na ɔretwam no, ɔhunuu onipa bi a n’ani afira firi n’awoɔ mu. 2#Luk 13.2 Na n’asuafoɔ bisaa no sɛ: Rabi, hwan na ɔyɛɛ bɔne, oyi anaa n’awofoɔ, sɛ wɔwoo no onifirani yi? 3#Yoh 11.4 Yesu buaa sɛ: Ɛnyɛ oyi, anaa n’awofoɔ na wɔyɛɛ bɔne, na mmom sɛ Nyankopɔn nnwuma bɛda adi wɔ ne mu ntira. 4#Yoh 5.17 Ɛsɛ yɛn sɛ adekyeeɛ wɔ hɔ yi, yɛyɛ deɛ ɔsomaa me no nnwuma; anadwo reba a obiara ntumi nyɛ adwuma. 5#Yoh 8.12 Mewɔ wiase yi, mene wiase hann. 6#Mar 8.23 Ɔkaa saa no, ɔtoo ntasuo guu fam, na ɔde ntasuo no fraa dɔteɛ, na ɔde dɔteɛ no sraa onifirani no aniwa so, 7na ɔka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Kɔ, kɔhohoro so wɔ Ɔtadeɛ Siloa mu (ne nkyerɛaseɛ ne: Deɛ wɔasoma no). Ɛnna ɔsii mu kɔeɛ kɔhohoroo soɔ, na ɔbaeɛ, na ɔhunu adeɛ.
N’afipamfoɔ asɛmmisa
8Ɛnna amannifoɔ ne wɔn a kane wɔhunuu no sɛ ɔyɛ ɔsrɛsrɛfoɔ no kaa sɛ: Ɛnyɛ oyi na na ɔte hɔ srɛsrɛ adeɛ no? 9Ebinom se: Ɔno ni! Na ebinom nso se: Ɔsɛ no. Na ɔno ara se: Mene no. 10Ɛnna wɔbisaa no sɛ: Ɛyɛɛ dɛn na w’ani bueeɛ? 11Ɔbua kaa sɛ: Onipa bi a wɔfrɛ no Yesu na ɔpɔtɔɔ dɔteɛ de sraa m’ani soɔ, na ɔka kyerɛɛ me sɛ: Kɔ Ɔtadeɛ Siloa mu kɔhohoro so. Na mekɔ mekɔhohoroo soɔ no, na mehunuu adeɛ. 12Ɛnna wɔbisaa no sɛ: Ɔwɔ he? Ɔse: Mennim.
Farisifoɔ asɛmmisa
13Wɔde deɛ anka ɔyɛ onifirani no kɔɔ Farisifoɔ nkyɛn. 14#Yoh 5.9 Nso da a Yesu pɔtɔɔ dɔteɛ na ɔbuee n’ani no yɛ homeda. 15Ɛnna Farisifoɔ no nso bisaa no bio sɛdeɛ ɛyɛeɛ na ɔhunuu adeɛ. Na ɔsee wɔn sɛ: Dɔteɛ na ɔde sraa m’ani soɔ, na mekɔhohoroo soɔ, na mehunu adeɛ yi. 16#Yoh 9.31; 9.33; 7.43 Ɛnna Farisifoɔ no mu bi kaa sɛ: Onipa yi mfiri Nyankopɔn nkyɛn, ɛfiri sɛ, ɔnni homeda. Ebinom se: Ɛbɛyɛ dɛn na onipa debɔneyɛni bɛtumi ayɛ nsɛnkyerɛnneɛ a ɛte seyie? Na mpaepaemu baa wɔn mu. 17Ɛnna wɔsee onifirani no bio sɛ: Wo deɛ, woka deɛn ne ho, sɛ ɔbuee w’ani no? Na ɔse: Ɔyɛ odiyifoɔ.
N’awofoɔ hɔ asɛmmisa
18Nso na Yudafoɔ no nnye ne ho nsɛm no nni, sɛ anka ɔyɛ onifirani na ɔhunuu adeɛ, de kɔsii sɛ wɔfrɛɛ deɛ ɔhunuu adeɛ no awofoɔ, 19na wɔbisaa wɔn sɛ: Mo ba a moka sɛ wɔwoo no onifirani no ni anaa? Afei ɛyɛɛ dɛn na ɔhunu adeɛ yi? 20N’awofoɔ buaa wɔn kaa sɛ: Yɛnim sɛ yɛn ba ni, na wɔwoo no onifirani; 21na sɛ ɛyɛeɛ na afei ɔhunu adeɛ yi deɛ, yɛnnim. Na bio nso onipa korɔ a ɔbuee n’ani no, yɛn deɛ, yɛnnim; mommisa no, wanyini, na ɔno ara bɛkasa ama ne ho. 22#Yoh 7.13; 12.42 N’awofoɔ kaa yei, ɛfiri sɛ na wɔsuro Yudafoɔ no; na Yudafoɔ no apam dada sɛ, sɛ obi pae mu ka sɛ ɔno ne Kristo no a, wɔbɛtu no afiri hyiadan mu. 23Yei nti na n’awofoɔ kaa sɛ: Wanyini, mommisa no.
Farisifoɔ pam no
24 # Yos 7.19 Ɛnna wɔfrɛɛ onipa a anka ɔyɛ onifirani no ne mprenu soɔ, na wɔsee no sɛ: Fa animuonyam ma Onyankopɔn! Yɛn deɛ, yɛnim sɛ onipa yi yɛ ɔdebɔneyɛni. 25Ɛnna ɔbua kaa sɛ: Sɛ ɔyɛ ɔdebɔneyɛni a, mennim; adeɛ baako na menim, sɛ na anka meyɛ onifirani, na afei deɛ mehunu adeɛ. 26Na wɔsee no sɛ: Ɛdeɛn na ɔyɛɛ woɔ? Ɔbuee w’ani no sɛn? 27Ɔbuaa wɔn sɛ: Maka makyerɛ mo dada, na moante? Ɛdeɛn na mopɛ sɛ mote bio? Mo nso mopɛ sɛ modane n’asuafoɔ anaa? 28Wɔyaa no, na wɔkaa sɛ: Wo na woyɛ ne suani; na yɛn deɛ, Mose asuafoɔ ne yɛn. 29Yɛnim sɛ Onyankopɔn kasa kyerɛɛ Mose; na oyi deɛ, yɛnnim faako a ɔfire. 30Onipa no bua see wɔn sɛ: Yei na ɛyɛ nwanwa, sɛ monnim faako a ɔfire, nanso ɔbuee m’ani. 31#Yes 1.15; Mmb 15.29 Na yɛnim sɛ Onyankopɔn ntie adebɔneyɛfoɔ; na sɛ obi fɛre Onyankopɔn na ɔyɛ deɛ ɔpɛ a, ɔno na ɔtie no. 32Ɛfiri wiase mfitiaseɛ, wɔntee sɛ obi abue deɛ wɔwoo no onifirani ani pɛn. 33#Yoh 9.16 Sɛ oyi mfiri Nyankopɔn nkyɛn a, anka ɔrentumi nyɛ hwee. 34#Yoh 9.2 Wɔbua see no sɛ: Wo deɛ, bɔne mu koraa na wɔwoo woɔ, na wo na wokyerɛkyerɛ yɛn? Na wɔpamm no firii adi.
Onifirani no gye Yesu di
35Yesu tee sɛ wɔapam no afiri adie; na ɔhunuu no no, ɔbisaa sɛ: Wogye Onipa Ba no di anaa? 36Ɔbuaa sɛ: Hwan ne no, Owura, na mennye no menni? 37#Yoh 4.26 Na Yesu see no sɛ: Woahu no, na deɛ ɔne wo rekasa yi, ɔne no. 38Na ɔse: Megye medi, Awurade! Na ɔkoto sɔree no.
Farisifoɔ anifira
39 # Mat 13.11-15 Na Yesu kaa sɛ: Atemmuo nti na mebaa wiase, na wɔn a wɔnhunu adeɛ no ahunu, na wɔn a wɔhunu adeɛ no adane anifirafoɔ. 40Na Farisifoɔ no mu bi a wɔne no wɔ hɔ no tee nsɛm yi, na wɔsee no sɛ: Na yɛn nso yɛyɛ anifirafoɔ? 41#Mmb 26.12 Yesu bua see wɔn sɛ: Sɛ moyɛ anifirafoɔ a, anka monni bɔne; na sɛ mose: Yɛhunu adeɛ enti, na mo bɔne aka.

Na ɔretwam no, ɔhunuu onipa bi a n’ani afira firi n’awoɔ mu. Na n’asuafoɔ bisaa no sɛ: Rabi, hwan na ɔyɛɛ bɔne, oyi anaa n’awofoɔ, sɛ wɔwoo no onifirani yi? Yesu buaa sɛ: Ɛnyɛ oyi, anaa n’awofoɔ na wɔyɛɛ bɔne, na mmom sɛ Nyankopɔn nnwuma bɛda adi wɔ ne mu ntira. Ɛsɛ yɛn sɛ adekyeeɛ wɔ hɔ yi, yɛyɛ deɛ ɔsomaa me no nnwuma; anadwo reba a obiara ntumi nyɛ adwuma. Mewɔ wiase yi, mene wiase hann. Ɔkaa saa no, ɔtoo ntasuo guu fam, na ɔde ntasuo no fraa dɔteɛ, na ɔde dɔteɛ no sraa onifirani no aniwa so, na ɔka kyerɛɛ no sɛ: Kɔ, kɔhohoro so wɔ Ɔtadeɛ Siloa mu (ne nkyerɛaseɛ ne: Deɛ wɔasoma no). Ɛnna ɔsii mu kɔeɛ kɔhohoroo soɔ, na ɔbaeɛ, na ɔhunu adeɛ.

Ɛnna amannifoɔ ne wɔn a kane wɔhunuu no sɛ ɔyɛ ɔsrɛsrɛfoɔ no kaa sɛ: Ɛnyɛ oyi na na ɔte hɔ srɛsrɛ adeɛ no? Ebinom se: Ɔno ni! Na ebinom nso se: Ɔsɛ no. Na ɔno ara se: Mene no. Ɛnna wɔbisaa no sɛ: Ɛyɛɛ dɛn na w’ani bueeɛ? Ɔbua kaa sɛ: Onipa bi a wɔfrɛ no Yesu na ɔpɔtɔɔ dɔteɛ de sraa m’ani soɔ, na ɔka kyerɛɛ me sɛ: Kɔ Ɔtadeɛ Siloa mu kɔhohoro so. Na mekɔ mekɔhohoroo soɔ no, na mehunuu adeɛ. Ɛnna wɔbisaa no sɛ: Ɔwɔ he? Ɔse: Mennim.

Wɔde deɛ anka ɔyɛ onifirani no kɔɔ Farisifoɔ nkyɛn. Nso da a Yesu pɔtɔɔ dɔteɛ na ɔbuee n’ani no yɛ homeda. Ɛnna Farisifoɔ no nso bisaa no bio sɛdeɛ ɛyɛeɛ na ɔhunuu adeɛ. Na ɔsee wɔn sɛ: Dɔteɛ na ɔde sraa m’ani soɔ, na mekɔhohoroo soɔ, na mehunu adeɛ yi. Ɛnna Farisifoɔ no mu bi kaa sɛ: Onipa yi mfiri Nyankopɔn nkyɛn, ɛfiri sɛ, ɔnni homeda. Ebinom se: Ɛbɛyɛ dɛn na onipa debɔneyɛni bɛtumi ayɛ nsɛnkyerɛnneɛ a ɛte seyie? Na mpaepaemu baa wɔn mu. Ɛnna wɔsee onifirani no bio sɛ: Wo deɛ, woka deɛn ne ho, sɛ ɔbuee w’ani no? Na ɔse: Ɔyɛ odiyifoɔ.

Nso na Yudafoɔ no nnye ne ho nsɛm no nni, sɛ anka ɔyɛ onifirani na ɔhunuu adeɛ, de kɔsii sɛ wɔfrɛɛ deɛ ɔhunuu adeɛ no awofoɔ, na wɔbisaa wɔn sɛ: Mo ba a moka sɛ wɔwoo no onifirani no ni anaa? Afei ɛyɛɛ dɛn na ɔhunu adeɛ yi? N’awofoɔ buaa wɔn kaa sɛ: Yɛnim sɛ yɛn ba ni, na wɔwoo no onifirani; na sɛ ɛyɛeɛ na afei ɔhunu adeɛ yi deɛ, yɛnnim. Na bio nso onipa korɔ a ɔbuee n’ani no, yɛn deɛ, yɛnnim; mommisa no, wanyini, na ɔno ara bɛkasa ama ne ho. N’awofoɔ kaa yei, ɛfiri sɛ na wɔsuro Yudafoɔ no; na Yudafoɔ no apam dada sɛ, sɛ obi pae mu ka sɛ ɔno ne Kristo no a, wɔbɛtu no afiri hyiadan mu. Yei nti na n’awofoɔ kaa sɛ: Wanyini, mommisa no.

Ɛnna wɔfrɛɛ onipa a anka ɔyɛ onifirani no ne mprenu soɔ, na wɔsee no sɛ: Fa animuonyam ma Onyankopɔn! Yɛn deɛ, yɛnim sɛ onipa yi yɛ ɔdebɔneyɛni. Ɛnna ɔbua kaa sɛ: Sɛ ɔyɛ ɔdebɔneyɛni a, mennim; adeɛ baako na menim, sɛ na anka meyɛ onifirani, na afei deɛ mehunu adeɛ. Na wɔsee no sɛ: Ɛdeɛn na ɔyɛɛ woɔ? Ɔbuee w’ani no sɛn? Ɔbuaa wɔn sɛ: Maka makyerɛ mo dada, na moante? Ɛdeɛn na mopɛ sɛ mote bio? Mo nso mopɛ sɛ modane n’asuafoɔ anaa? Wɔyaa no, na wɔkaa sɛ: Wo na woyɛ ne suani; na yɛn deɛ, Mose asuafoɔ ne yɛn. Yɛnim sɛ Onyankopɔn kasa kyerɛɛ Mose; na oyi deɛ, yɛnnim faako a ɔfire. Onipa no bua see wɔn sɛ: Yei na ɛyɛ nwanwa, sɛ monnim faako a ɔfire, nanso ɔbuee m’ani. Na yɛnim sɛ Onyankopɔn ntie adebɔneyɛfoɔ; na sɛ obi fɛre Onyankopɔn na ɔyɛ deɛ ɔpɛ a, ɔno na ɔtie no. Ɛfiri wiase mfitiaseɛ, wɔntee sɛ obi abue deɛ wɔwoo no onifirani ani pɛn. Sɛ oyi mfiri Nyankopɔn nkyɛn a, anka ɔrentumi nyɛ hwee. Wɔbua see no sɛ: Wo deɛ, bɔne mu koraa na wɔwoo woɔ, na wo na wokyerɛkyerɛ yɛn? Na wɔpamm no firii adi.

Yesu tee sɛ wɔapam no afiri adie; na ɔhunuu no no, ɔbisaa sɛ: Wogye Onipa Ba no di anaa? Ɔbuaa sɛ: Hwan ne no, Owura, na mennye no menni? Na Yesu see no sɛ: Woahu no, na deɛ ɔne wo rekasa yi, ɔne no. Na ɔse: Megye medi, Awurade! Na ɔkoto sɔree no.

Na Yesu kaa sɛ: Atemmuo nti na mebaa wiase, na wɔn a wɔnhunu adeɛ no ahunu, na wɔn a wɔhunu adeɛ no adane anifirafoɔ. Na Farisifoɔ no mu bi a wɔne no wɔ hɔ no tee nsɛm yi, na wɔsee no sɛ: Na yɛn nso yɛyɛ anifirafoɔ? Yesu bua see wɔn sɛ: Sɛ moyɛ anifirafoɔ a, anka monni bɔne; na sɛ mose: Yɛhunu adeɛ enti, na mo bɔne aka.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
